metadata.limitations: Community map footprints and tags; not surveyed accuracy, current elevations, facade details, interiors or verified door positions. Missing heights and ground levels require documented assumptions. Geographic extents limited to selected bbox.

transform.projection: WGS84 ECEF to local tangent East/North at elevation 0; school-aligned orthonormal rotation
transform.formula: x=dot(enu-origin,x_unit); z=dot(enu-origin,z_unit). THREE y is vertical. Blender world X=x, Y=-z, Z=height. Do not nonuniformly scale the geographic geometry.
transform.orientation: Main long school wing horizontal (x), courtyard +z, main exterior behind courtyard at z<=0. +x approximately southeast, +z approximately southwest.

school.suggested_position_limitations: Spawn and gameplay door are design suggestions on open courtyard/main wall; door position has not been established by a photograph or plan.
